converter: cth_convert_sym_v9.py (a copy of docx_text() of the workbench converter harvest/fetch/fetch-source.py that also maps Symbol-font and private-use characters; kept outside the repository); the first deposit used harvest/fetch/fetch-source.py (workbench)

symbol_repair_2026_11_07.previous_converter: harvest/fetch/fetch-source.py (docx_text), the converter of the 2026-10-13 deposit
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.from: the same Word document of C2004A05226 (download_sha256 3e7e49fcd7b7ba8b6fb7b05b2e6cc15dc1a885b303f3a32f2e4660663e946712, unchanged)
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.why: docx_text() dropped characters Word writes as Symbol-font w:sym elements. cth_convert_sym_v9.py maps them to Unicode (Symbol F05B [, F05D ], F0BE —, F0B4 × and the like), Wingdings boxes to "[ ]", and private-use code points U+F0xx the same way; run with its mapping switched off it reproduces the first deposit byte for byte.
symbol_repair_2026_11_07.what_changed: A diff against the first deposit shows only these 3 lines changed (same 23 lines, 5 characters more): line 8 '[Assented to 19 September 1997]' (Symbol F05B [ and F05D ] restored); line 20 '[Minister’s second reading speech made in—' (Symbol [ and em dash F0BE — restored); line 22 'Senate on 3 September 1997]' (Symbol ] restored).
